step1_figure.circuit_type: Beta-Multiplier Current Reference with Feedback Amplifier for Short-Channel CMOS
step1_figure.description: Figure 20.22 depicts an improved Beta-multiplier reference for short-channel devices, utilizing an integrated differential amplifier (MA1-MA4) to regulate the drain voltages of M1 and M2 to be equal (Vbiasn = Vreg) and compensation capacitors (MCP, MCN) with startup circuitry (MSU1-MSU3).

reference_current.description: DC reference current (IREF) generated by the Beta-multiplier core

equation.explanation: Expresses the reference current determined by resistor R, the NMOS transconductance parameter beta1, and the channel width multiplication factor K = W2/W1.
equation.assumptions: Square-law long-channel behavior, saturation region operation, zero channel-length modulation

sky130_expected.reasoning: Real submicron devices with velocity saturation and finite lambda lead to slight deviations around 2-5 uA.

transconductance_gm.description: Transconductance gm of transistor M1, stabilized by the Beta-multiplier topology

equation.explanation: For K = 4, gm simplifies to 1/R, creating a constant-gm reference independent of process shifts.

vov_overdrive_voltage.description: NMOS gate overdrive voltage (Vovn = VGS - VTHN)

equation.explanation: Calculates the effective saturation overdrive voltage VDS,sat required across M1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Small overdrive voltage ensures high gm and low headroom consumption.

minimum_supply_voltage.description: Minimum supply voltage VDD,min for reference regulation

equation.explanation: Sum of the minimum PMOS drain-to-source saturation voltage and M1 gate-to-source voltage.
equation.assumptions: M3 and M1 remain in saturation

sky130_expected.reasoning: Ensures all mirror transistors remain out of triode.

drain_voltage_mismatch.description: Difference between regulated drain voltage Vreg and reference drain voltage Vbiasn

equation.explanation: Residual error voltage between M1 and M2 drains determined by the finite gain of the differential amplifier.
equation.assumptions: Differential amplifier in high-gain active region

sky130_expected.calculation: With differential pair gain around 15-25 V/V and Vbiasp around 1.1 V relative to rail: Delta_V is around 5 mV to 20 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Active differential feedback drives the two drains to nearly identical potentials.

supply_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of reference current to supply voltage variations (dIREF / dVDD)

equation.explanation: Rate of change of the reference current with respect to supply voltage VDD.
equation.assumptions: Feedback amplifier actively eliminates drain-source voltage differences

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to active drain-potential regulation from diff-amp MA1-MA4, supply sensitivity is reduced to less than 100 nA/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Feedback significantly improves line sensitivity compared to an unbuffered Beta-multiplier.

startup_quiescent_current.description: Current through startup switch MSU3 under normal steady-state operation

equation.explanation: During normal steady-state operation, the startup circuit must turn off completely to avoid disturbing the reference current.
equation.assumptions: M1-M4 are active and Vbiasn is sufficiently high to pull MSU1 drain down and shut off MSU3

sky130_expected.calculation: MSU1 turns on, pulling gate of MSU3 to ground, placing MSU3 in subthreshold cutoff with I_MSU3 < 1 pA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Startup branch is completely disabled in nominal operation.

step3_testbench.description: Simulates DC operating point, DC supply sweep, and transient step response for the improved Beta-multiplier current reference.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Improved Beta-Multiplier Reference (Fig. 20.22)
.lib "/home/designer/shared_pdks/sky130A/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Sizing Parameters
.param W_xm1=10u    L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=40u    L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=20u    L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=20u    L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xma3=20u   L_xma3=0.5u
.param W_xma4=20u   L_xma4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=10u    L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=10u    L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xmsu1=10u  L_xmsu1=0.5u
.param W_xmsu2=2u   L_xmsu2=5.0u
.param W_xmsu3=2u   L_xmsu3=0.5u
.param W_xm7=10u    L_xm7=10u
.param W_xm8=10u    L_xm8=10u

* Supply Voltage
VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Circuit Netlist (Fig. 20.22 DUT)
xmsu2 N002 N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu2} l={L_xmsu2}
xmsu1 N002 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu1} l={L_xmsu1}
xmsu3 Vbiasp N002 Vbiasn 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
xm3 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 N003 Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm1 Vbiasn Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N003 N003 N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
R1 N004 0 5500.0
xma4 Vbiasp N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xma4} l={L_xma4}
xma3 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xma3} l={L_xma3}
xm5 N001 N003 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 Vbiasp Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7 VDD Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 0 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}

.control
* 1. Operating Point Analysis
op
let iref_val = @m.xm1.msky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8[id]
let gm_m1 = @m.xm1.msky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8[gm]
let vgs_m1 = v(Vbiasn)
let vov_m1 = vgs_m1 - 0.42
let delta_vreg = abs(v(N003) - v(Vbiasn))
let is_msu3 = abs(@m.xmsu3.msky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8[id])

print iref_val gm_m1 vgs_m1 vov_m1 delta_vreg is_msu3

* 2. DC Sweep Analysis for Supply Sensitivity and VDDmin
dc VDD 0 1.8 0.01
let iref_sweep = @m.xm1.msky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8[id]
let d_iref = deriv(iref_sweep)

meas dc iref_at_1v8 find iref_sweep at=1.8
meas dc iref_at_1v2 find iref_sweep at=1.2
meas dc sens_at_1v8 find d_iref at=1.8
meas dc vdd_min when iref_sweep=2.5u rise=1

* 3. Transient Analysis with Supply Ramp to observe Startup & Stability
alter VDD pulse(0 1.8 10n 10n 10n 1u 2u)
tran 1n 200n
meas tran iref_tran_end find @m.xm1.msky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8[id] at=180n

quit
.endc
.end
